title: Verify .NET test-runner recognition and evidence on Phoenix (MSTest, NUnit, xUnit) before the work-team pilot
outcome: Verify .NET test-runner recognition and evidence on Phoenix (MSTest, NUnit, xUnit) before the work-team pilot
acceptance: Recognition and parsing are proven on PhoenixCodeNav's real captured `dotnet test` output for each framework Phoenix actually uses (at least xUnit 2 on VSTest). The holder note quotes the exact command, the captured output excerpt and how it was classified.

Host-observed verification is proven in a scratch C# repository without submodules or LFS for xUnit on VSTest with a TRX logger: a passing and a deliberately failing `dotnet test` run are each recorded in Engram as host-observed verification with the correct status, and the failing run is recorded as failed and never as passed. The holder note quotes the command, exit code, recorded status and Engram record id for each run. It also states that NUnit, MSTest and Microsoft.Testing.Platform are not proven by this item, with the TermAl reference that tracks them.

The holder note states TermAl's credit rules that pilot users must follow (for example, that `dotnet test --no-build` is not credited and that passing evidence needs English output). It also states the Phoenix limitation: Git submodules make TermAl's content revision fail closed, so a run in Phoenix cannot become host-observed verification until TermAl w-c07c410dac75 is resolved. Every unrecognised form is listed with its TermAl fix reference.
No change is made to Phoenix except under its owner's normal authority, and NuGet credentials are not treated as a blocker.
